m.pg: Money making guide/Making unfinished ranarr potions
m.h:
Ranarr potion (unfinished) are used to create Prayer potions. Because these are often used to train Herblore, and adding clean ranarr to a vial of water gives little experience, many players avoid the tedium of making unfinished potions and buy them directly from the Grand Exchange. This opens up an opportunity to make unfinished ranarr potions for profit.

Using portable wells gives a 5% chance of making an extra potion and the scroll of cleansing gives a permanent 10% chance of not using up an ingredient when making potions. The bonuses of these two items increase the number of unfinished potions you can make, and the portable well also makes the process less click-intensive. With a portable well placed next to a bank chest, click on the bank chest and deposit your inventory and withdraw 14 herbs and 14 vials of water by using a bank preset, and repeat.

There is usually a portable well placed and maintained by someone else next to the bank chest in the Lumbridge Market in world 84. However, if there isn't one and no-one else provides one within a reasonable amount of time, you may have to use your own wells. Assuming the portable wells are bought at Grand Exchange prices, this will cost 19,248 gp coins per hour. 2,310 Ranarr potions can be made on an average raising the money per hour to .

rq.h: Use of Vis Wax Calculator (recommended)

m.h:
Interacting with the Rune Goldberg Machine found on the eastern side of the Runecrafting Guild opens up an interface in which various runes may be input into three slots. A coloured face indicates how optimal each rune is (in that slot), with a green smiley being most optimal and a red frown being least optimal. The combination of runes required to produce the full 100 vis wax output changes daily and varies slightly between players. The runes follow these trends:

  • The first rune will be the same for all players.
  • The second rune varies between three runes for all players.
  • The third rune is completely random and depends on trial-and-error to find.
    • Alternatively, with level 99 Runecrafting, the skillcape perk divulges the third rune.

Using the calculator can give you the most profitable set of daily runes.

The trial-and-error aspect of the machine also takes a toll on the overall profit, by increasing the number of runes needed slightly with each unsuccessful attempt. As such, to mitigate loss, players may wish to join a dedicated Friends Chat which may provide information on the first two rune slots.

Note:

  • The runes can be input directly from the bank without needing to take them to the machine.
  • Depending on market value, certain runes (usually combination runes) may cause a loss of profit. To prevent this, players are recommended to substitute that slot with a less optimal rune that yields a higher net profit.

m.pg: Money making guide/Making waterfiend binding contracts

rq.nt: for increased healing using Soul Split

rq.h: or Vampyrism or Penance
or Defence cape for sign of life perk or ranged cape for enchanted arrows perk

inp.nt: Using Aggroverload is cheaper than using overload and aggression potion separately. Alternatively, players can use [[Holy aggroverload]] to maintain prayer points as well.
For armour repairs / divine charges (assuming augmented t90 gear and high Smithing)

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 1,000 kills an hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your kill speed.

Approximately 36 empty binding pouches can be made per minute with the necessary materials using a yak and attuned crystal teleport seed at the Prifddinas summoning obelisk. Alternatively, the Taverley shop method can be used to create empty contracts, but it is more expensive.

Bring all binding pouches, along with an aggroverload + restores or holy aggroverload, magic notepaper, and optionally food into the Ancient caverns. Use soul split and anguish when attacking the waterfiends. They deal potentially large damage from both ranged and melee, so deflection curses are not practical. Using the Penance or Vampyrism aspects is recommended. A great place to stand with the effects of the aggression potion is 3 tiles northeast of the fairy ring. Waterfiends tend to not have any great drops, so it may not be worth the time to pick them up. They drop salvages infrequently, so a spring cleaner may not be worth bringing. Use the magic notepaper on the contracts to make more inventory space.

rq.h: Wearing any pair of gloves with an armour stat, such as: Gauntlets, Vambraces, or Leather gloves

rq.nt: to skip the warning dialogue on cave entry

m.h:
Weapon poison++ is made by using cave nightshade on a vial of coconut milk and poison ivy berries. Cave nightshade only spawns inside the Skavid caves under Gu'Tanoth, east of Castle Wars, and is untradeable, so the spawn time of the nightshade is the limiting factor in how fast weapon poison++ can be made.

The easiest way to get there is by teleporting to the Yanille lodestone and walking to the most northern cave entrance marked on the map to the right. A skavid map is required to enter. A light source is required to prevent damage from swarming insects. Armoured gloves are required to pick cave nightshades. Cave nightshades can be noted with magic notepaper by using the nightshade on the paper, but not vice versa. Signs of the porter may also be used to bank the harvest.

It takes approximately 30 seconds for each of the plants to respawn (with a small amount of randomness), and both caves contain 7 plants. You can gather more quickly by hopping world rather than waiting for respawns.

The varanusaur envenomed perk gives a 10% chance to make 4 doses instead of 3 doses when mixing these potions.

This guide assumes that 2500 potions are mixed per hour. It is possible to obtain rates of up to 2800 potions per hour by using a beast of burden such as a pack yak along with bank presets to optimise time spent potion making. This will require a higher intensity in order to manage both inventories.

It is recommended to use your own portable wells on a world which you have a good connection to as the benefits outweigh the costs in most cases. Buying portable wells will cost 19,248 gp per hour. The cost can be avoided by using wells placed by other players.

When selling the potions its generally best to decant to 4 dose potions first for the best price. However it may be more profitable to sell as a 3 dose.

If you are missing any of the required items or inputs profits will be affected by the following amounts:

  • Scroll of cleansing - -45750+-538000 gp
  • Portable wells + Brooch of the Gods - -5642892.084375 + 19248 gp
  • Brooch of the Gods - -2,821,446.04 gp
  • Modified botanist's mask - -2,955,800.62 gp
  • 3 pieces of factory outfit - -1,873,453.33 gp
  • Botanist's amulets - -888174.045 + 489750 gp (should this be a positive number then using amulets will lose you money and therefore you shouldn't use them).

m.pg: Money making guide/Making yew incense sticks

rq.h: or Pyro-matic or Augmented crystal tinderbox (recommended)

m.h: An inventory of 28 Yew Logs can be crafted into 14 Yew incense sticks. This can be done at any bank. Setting a bank preset to be 28 Yew logs can make the banking process slightly easier. Players can simply buy yew logs at the Grand Exchange, process and resell the sticks. It takes 42 seconds to process 28 yew logs, so a full load of 2000 will take at least 3024 seconds, or 50 minutes.

Replacement Equipment

If you're missing any of the items, the replacement method is detailed below. Each replacement will increase the time it takes to complete the run

  • Most items can simply be replaced by using the closest lodestone and running further
  • Fremennik sea boots 4 can be replaced with Fremennik Province lodestone and running north
  • Attuned crystal teleport seed can be replaced with Prifddinas lodestone and running west then south or Crystal teleport seed
  • Wilderness sword 1 is useful for bladed dive and teleporting to Edgeville; lodestone or another weapon can be a replacement

  • Karamja gloves 3 can be replaced by using the Shilo Village cart system, which is run by Hajedy in Brimhaven
  • Mask of the Dagannoth can be replaced with Lighthouse Teleport or teleporting with Games necklace to Barbarian Outpost and hopping over the stones
  • Getting to Etceteria is via the Spirit tree next to Player-owned farm. This can be replaced by teleporting to Miscellania via the Luck of the Dwarves and then running east to Etceteria
  • Luck of the Dwarves can be replaced with using the ring of wealth to teleport to Miscellania and then running east. Keldagrim can be travelled to by using the Keldagrim trapdoor
  • Slayer cape (t) can be replaced with using the Edgeville lever after buying runes from the Battle Runes, then running west

Replacement inventory items

  • Ape Atoll Teleport can be replaced by using Fairy ring or travelling via Daero at the of the Grand Tree
  • Ectophial can be replaced with Canifis lodestone and running East
  • Pack yak pouch can be replaced with a smaller Beast of Burden such as War tortoise or Spirit terrorbird
  • Magic notepaper can be replaced with Beast of Burden and more banking inbetween teleports, ideally War's Retreat
  • Amulet of glory can be replaced with Al Kharid lodestone and running south
  • Explorer's ring 3 can be replaced with Taverley lodestone and running north
Notes
  • It's highly recommended to use Law runes for fast teleports to lodestones
  • There are other shop runs that haven't been included in this guide, due to inventory space and profit they have been excluded from this guide. This potentially could change at a later date with new moneymakers coming out with each update
  • The more traditional moneymakers such as vis, raids, pof and flasks haven't been included as this is purely shops to save on having to bank and change items
  • The output list above shows the large number of items which you may not have in your bank, so it's worth checking that you have space for potentially 51 new items
  • The Wilderness sword 1, Explorer's ring 3, Karamja gloves 3, and the Fremennik sea boots 4 are the minimum task difficulty required without using replacements, if you own a higher tier use that instead
  • If you're missing any of the requirements, skip the step
  • This guide involves going into the Wilderness, so make sure you aren't skulled beforehand
  • Due to price changes on the Grand Exchange, some items may result in a net loss. Check the shop's stock on their pages to verify

rq.h: 40 Mining (50 Mining (recommended))

m.h:
Adamantite ore is an item that often sells for a high price, as it can be smelted in a furnace with a luminite ore to form an adamant bar, requiring level 40 Smithing.

There are several locations to mine adamantite, but one of the best places to mine adamantite is at the Rimmington mine (see page for banking details).

First, go to the ore locations and start mining. Once the player have a full inventory, go to the nearest bank, deposit the ores, return to the ore location, and repeat. The player may also find sedimentary geode while mining, which can increase the profit slightly. The player should also keep their stamina up, and mine any rockertunity the player may encounter, as it can increase the profit.

For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.

rq.nt: if not using signs of the porter

m.h:
This is an excellent way to mine fairly AFK for a long period of time, and the metamorphic geode does provide some additional income over time, but it is highly dependent on luck and having the Refined perk. Alternatively, the player can use the Fortune perk to occasionally mine an extra ore. Stone spirit and ore prices fluctuate significantly on the Grand Exchange, so be sure to test prices before heavily investing in materials. For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear, see the mining rate calculator.

Further profit could be achieved via the following means:

  • A grace of the elves allows Seren spirits to spawn, which reward the player with an item from the rare drop table. It can also be charged with signs of the porter to bank items. However, be aware that the grace of the elves has a high upfront cost as it becomes permanently untradeable once equipped for the first time.
  • Having a Luck of the Dwarves equipped allows the player to obtain the best drops from Seren spirits and also increases the chance of getting metamorphic geodes.
  • Tagga's corehammer gives the player +10% critical strike chance and +35 critical strike damage. It also has a 8.5% chance of producing deathspore arrow tips.

m.t: Mining light and dark animica (During Trahaearn Voice of Seren)

rq.h: 90 Mining (99 Mining (recommended) for Mining cape)
Grace of the elves (Seren spirits) with Luck of the Dwarves
or Elder rune ore box or signs of the porter
Plague's End

m.h:
Light and Dark animica are high level tier 90 ores, used to make Elder rune bars.

Depending on the ore you are mining, it is either 1,378,800 gp for Light animica or 1,314,300 gp for Dark animica.

When the hour begins, drink a sip of perfect juju mining potion, summon a lava titan, and if on legacy mode, use dragon battleaxe's special. You will want to find a world with two of the same rocks close to each other, so a rockertunity will spawn next to you. Click these for extra experience and more damage, meaning faster rocks. You can also 4 tick to keep your stamina up and mine faster.

If you do not have Grace of the elves or signs of the porter, a bank and a furnace are reasonably close. An elder rune box can initially hold up to 100 ore, and level 95 Mining and completion of the Everything Is Oresome achievement each increase the capacity by 20, up to a total maximum of 140 ore. Igneous and metamorphic geodes have a chance to appear in your inventory, while metamorphic geodes are quite rare, you can expect between 0-5 (4-5 rare) for 1 hour of mining animica.

If one were to use stone spirits, they would make 2757600-189600 gp for light animica and 2628600-160200 gp for dark animica.

Profit could be further increased with a Tagga's corehammer as it gives the player +10% critical strike chance and +35 critical strike damage, and also has a 8.5% chance of producing deathspore arrow tips.

For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.

rq.h: Pickaxe of earth and song with Honed 6
Shooting Star buff recommended

m.post:
It is recommended to use the Wilderness (level 54) Pirates' Hideout mine as its close proximity to a metal bank negates the need for an ore box. Be sure to opt out of PvP as this location is in the deep Wilderness.

Further profit could be achieved via the following means:

  • With level 99 Mining or above, the Mining cape gives a 5% chance to obtain double ore.
  • A grace of the elves allows Seren spirits to spawn, which reward the player with an item from the rare drop table. However, be aware that the grace of the elves has a high upfront cost as it becomes permanently untradeable once equipped for the first time.
  • Having a Luck of the Dwarves equipped allows the player to obtain the best drops from Seren spirits and also increases the chance of getting metamorphic geodes.
  • Tagga's corehammer gives the player +10% critical strike chance and +35 critical strike damage. It also has a 6.2% chance of producing deathspore arrow tips.
  • The Shooting Star buff gives a 25% chance of receiving double ore for 15 to 60 minutes, depending on the upgrade unlocked.

m.h:
Clay is an item that is always in demand due to soft clay being used in Crafting. There are many locations to mine clay, but one of the best locations is in the Burthorpe mines, located southwest of the bank. Once you have a full inventory, leave the mines and deposit your clay at the bank.

Players can also use Bracelet of clay to further boost their hourly profit. Each bracelet will allow the player to mine 28 soft clay before disintegrating. Players will need a bit more than 33 bracelets and make a profit of 1043400 - 41997.857142857 gp per hour.

It takes around 40 seconds running to and from the bank. Depending on your mining level and pickaxe your profit will be a bit different. There will be no increased ore per hour after steel pickaxe. m.pg: Money making guide/Mining concentrated coal rocks

rq.h: Golden mining suit and/or Magic golem outfit (recommended)

m.h:
Coal can be mined from concentrated coal deposits in the Living Rock Caverns. Unlike regular coal rocks, concentrated coal deposits yield five pieces of coal at once.

Note that the coal obtained in the above example requires 4-ticking. Afk methods will produce around 6000 ore.

It is recommended to use a lava titan, requiring 83 Summoning, to give an extra 10 mining damage to increase the speed at which the coal is mined. The golden mining suit gives a 5% increase to experience when worn, but it does not increase the rate that the coal is mined. A full decorated mining urn can be teleported for 625 mining experience, but it does not affect the rate of obtaining coal and it cannot be sold. For the purpose of money making, it is not recommended to use urns as they take up inventory space and provide no benefit to the amount of coal earned. For a close approximation of coal mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.

Be sure to assign an action bar slot for your ore box if not using signs of the porter, to avoid wasting extra time depositing coal.

Living rock creatures roam the cavern and will attack you while you are mining, unless you are wearing the magic golem outfit, which removes their aggression. World 83 is the official Living Rock Caverns world; the unofficial worlds are 77, 88, and 96. Hiding behind rocks or wearing the Magic golem outfit is recommended to avoid taking damage.

Coal stone spirits will double the coal mined, thus increasing profits, even when taking into account the cost of the stone spirits. Signs of the porter can be used to send ore to the metal bank; only one charge will be used to send all five mined coal to the bank, making this very effective for long trips. Perfect juju mining potion has a 10% chance of giving coal stone spirits for every mining action, and restores mining stamina upon using a coal stone spirit. This helps gain back some of the cost of the stone spirits, while also restoring mining stamina and allowing the player to click less often to maintain good rates. Players should still buy coal stone spirits in advance to ensure that they don't run out.

However, if Coal Stone Spirits are used in conjunction with the potion, it is strongly advised to not store the stone spirits in the Ore Box, and it may be worth completely omitting the ore box if using Grace of the elves to maintain porter use. The reason for this is that the free Coal Stone Spirits will go to your inventory instead of the ore box, and will be used from there instead of the box. Upon a mining success, the game will check your inventory first for stone spirits, only using the ones from your box if there are none in your inventory. This means that when you receive a single Stone Spirit from your Potion effect, you will only receive 6 ore from your next mining success, as the ones in your box will be ignored, which can drastically reduce the GP per hour.

Using an augmented tool with the Honed perk can further increase yield while costing tool charges. It yields up to 12 extra Coal per hour per rank, up to 72 at rank 6, if the success chance is less than or equal 90% per mining tick.

Luck enhancing items such as the Ring of Wealth increase the likelihood of getting a metamorphic geode rather than an igneous geode.

Depositing the ore

Once your inventory and your ore box is full, you'll need to run back towards the Pulley lift at the entrance of the Living Rock Caverns. Simply use your Orebox on the Pulley to deposit all of your ore, then click deposit on the Pulley and right click and deposit all of the ore in your inventory. Be careful when depositing your inventory of ore, not to deposit your Orebox.

rq.h: Golden mining suit or Magic golem outfit (recommended)

m.h:
Gold ore can be mined from concentrated gold deposits in the Living Rock Caverns. Concentrated gold deposits yield five gold ores at once unlike normal gold rocks. There are four concentrated gold rock spawns, but it is recommended to use the two southern spawns that are closest to the bank deposit which is located in the centre of the cavern.

Note that the gold ore obtained in the above example requires 4-ticking. Afk methods will produce around 3780 ore. See

It is recommended to use a lava titan, requiring 83 Summoning, to give an extra 10 mining damage to increase the speed at which the gold ore is mined. The golden mining suit gives a 5% increase to experience when worn, but it does not increase the rate that the gold ore is mined. A full decorated mining urn can be teleported for 625 mining experience, but it does not affect the rate of obtaining ore and it cannot be sold. For the purpose of money making, it is not recommended to use urns as they take up inventory space and provide no benefit to the amount of gold ore earned. For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.

Be sure to assign an action bar slot for your ore box, to avoid wasting extra time depositing ore.

Living rock creatures roam the cavern and will attack you while you are mining, unless you are wearing the magic golem outfit, which removes their aggression. World 83 is the official Living Rock Caverns world; the unofficial worlds are 77, 88, and 96. Hiding behind rocks or wearing the Magic golem outfit is recommended to avoid taking damage.

Gold stone spirits will double the gold ore mined, thus increasing profits, even when taking into account the cost of the stone spirits. Signs of the porter can be used to send ore to the metal bank; only one charge will be used to send all five mined ores to the bank, making this very effective for long trips. Perfect juju mining potion has a 10% chance of giving gold stone spirits for every mining action, and restores mining stamina upon using a gold stone spirit. This helps gain back some of the cost of the stone spirits, while also restoring mining stamina and allowing the player to click less often to maintain good rates. The reason for this is that the free gold stone spirits will go to your backpack instead of the ore box, and will be used from there instead of the box. Depositing the ore

rq.h: 105 buckets

m.h: Level 92 Farming is required to raise dragons and have royal dragons in the large pens. Each pile of red dragon manure can be mucked to fill one bucket. Climb into the stile, hover over a pile of red dragon manure, and click "Muck out Dragon manure" to fill a bucket. Once you have 15 buckets of dragon manure, use them to fill a compost bin and then close it. Ultracompost takes 90 minutes to decompose in a bin, and each bin needs 15 buckets of dragon manure to produce ultracompost. A full bin will yield 15 buckets of ultracompost, which have a total value of 172,365 gp. Compost bins can be found at the following locations:

m.h:
The profit rate assumes you are opening chests at an effective rate of 2,000 per hour. Alchemist's keys have a buy limit of only 1,000 per 4 hours. They may need to be purchased ahead of time to open chests without running out.

Attune a boss portal in War's Retreat to The Zamorakian Undercity, which will cost 100,000 gp. Utilising either bladed dive or dive with mobile will greatly speed up the processing rate. When finished opening the chest with all keys from your inventory and pack yak, teleport to War's Retreat to restock on keys. After loading a preset that replenishes the keys in your inventory, surge north and enter the boss portal to The Zamorakian Undercity. Next surge south then north-west to the building with the chest. Profits can be further increased by using the cave nightshade and poison ivy berries to craft weapon poison++.
